estrogen, progesterone, oxytocin, relaxin, and prostaglandins in the delivery process.
questions.gold_answer:

the placenta rises sharply, oxytocin is released, relaxin loosens the connections between
the bones of the pelvis, and prostaglandins stimulate the smooth muscle of the uterus..
